[[Shumavar]] was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the Outer Rim Territories.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Shumavar was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space and was the site of a [[Battle of Shumavar (Clone Wars)|battle]], in which famous [[Shockball/Legends|Shockball]] player and Separatist hero [[Kob Mondray]] fought.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEAAC" /> Many years later, the planet was attacked by [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] invaders in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], it hosted a trade conference where the trader [[Bornan Thul]] had planned to meet with [[Nolaa Tarkona]], the leader of the [[Diversity Alliance]], to deliver a parcel. However, Thul never turned up once he realized that the parcel contained the coordinates for a [[Emperor's plague storehouse|storehouse]] containing a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-specific [[Emperor's Plague|plague]] that Tarkona planned to release into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
